scientific_integrity: The exact hull calculation is proved analytically. Symbolic and numerical checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive radii with 0<r<R; round planar disk and unweighted volume only. No uniformity as r/R approaches endpoints; historical priority not independently certified; higher-dimensional and nonround counterparts open in this result.
title: Exact illumination profile and a second-order transition for Euclidean ball-convex disks
